start.welcome: Hello! Welcome to the Taklifnoma bot. Create your own wedding invitation using the button below.

help.text:
Taklifnoma bot help:

/start — launch the bot and open the Mini App
/help — this help message

To create your wedding invitation, tap "Create invitation" inside the Mini App and fill in the details step by step. For questions or feedback, contact @taklifnoma_support.
